usedFor: api.video hosts your streams and Documint builds documents, so “Live Stream Ended” can feed “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “Live Stream Ended” in api.video, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: A finished broadcast becomes a document built from the stream details, ready to file or share.

watchOut: “New Video Created” in api.video is polling, so a new video reaches Documint after a scheduled check.
